newsitem.title: CANADA: Stone-Consolidated mill to resume production.
newsitem.headline: Stone-Consolidated mill to resume production.

text.p: Stone-Consolidated Corp said on Tuesday its Laurentide uncoated groundwoods papers mill in Grand-Mere, Quebec will resume production on Thursday.
The company said 60 percent of the mill's production on the number 11 machine will resume on Thursday and number 10 a few days later after a fire on January 4 extended a planned shutdown period.
The mill was scheduled to resume production on January 6, 1997, following a 13-day shutdown.
Stone-Consolidated said it was still too early to estimate the amount of lost production.
